evidence.claim: Card C07671-K2 shows a history entirely consisting of in-person retail transactions (product_cd W, addr1 264) over several months up to December 2016. The flagged transaction 3526826 is an online purchase for $35.66, representing a sudden channel shift to Card-Not-Present (CNP) activity. Device query failed and similar cases query was disabled, but the sudden pivot from exclusively in-person to an online transaction matches card-not-present fraud characteristics.
